server.description: RegEvidenceHub Waste: England waste registration, DWT readiness and permit-change preflight.

serverInfo.description: Read-only, evidence-linked England waste regulatory preflight for businesses, carriers, brokers, dealers, receiving sites and waste operators. It routes current waste operations, checks carrier/broker/dealer registration lifecycle questions, Digital Waste Tracking receiving-site readiness, permit-change impact and official-source health. It intentionally does not submit registrations, permits, exemptions or DWT records, manage regulator records, classify hazardous waste, assign waste codes, approve operations, or provide legal advice.
